title: Decem Theses V-VI: Either exemplar makes an AC Socius; Estates publicly professed the augmented as the prior
pass_a_gloss: V. Whoever receives either of these Confessions is an Associate of the Augsburg Confession, and cannot by right be excluded from the Religious Peace of the Empire. VI. The Electors, Princes, and Estates of the Empire have publicly professed the augmented Confession equally with the earlier one.
pass_b_english: V. Anyone who receives either of these Confessions is an associate of the Augsburg Confession, and cannot lawfully be shut out of the Empire's Religious Peace.
VI. Electors, Princes, and Imperial Estates have publicly professed the enlarged Confession no less than the earlier one.
source_text:
V.
Qui alterutram harum Confessionum recipit, Socius est Augustanae Confessionis, nec religiosa Imperii pace jure excludi potest.
VI.
Electores, Principes, ac Status Imperii, adauctam Confessionem aequè ac priorem, publice professi sunt.
